name: vsdev (NTLinux's first Windows kernel driver)

known_bugs.summary: Legacy `sc start` load path never called AddDevice, so the device object never existed even though the service reported RUNNING
known_bugs.workaround: VsdevCreateDeviceObject is now called directly from DriverEntry too, not only AddDevice

notes: Real seed entry: driver/vsdev/README.md and ROADMAP.md Phase 5 record two full live runs on a real ReactOS x64 kernel under QEMU (sc create/sc start -> STATE: RUNNING, then vsdev_test.exe's CreateFile/WriteFile/ReadFile round-trip -> PASS), reproduced after the legacy-load fix. PnP-triggered load path is still unverified - see ROADMAP.md Phase 14.
